result.brief: 提出 Clock Diffusion 半自回归连续扩散语言模型，用位置相关噪声调度实现变长生成与 KV 缓存，并给出 Cache Grab 高效采样器。
result.reason: Continuous diffusion language models with position-dependent noise schedules, semi-autoregressive generation, KV-cache support and efficient samplers directly match the continuous language model direction.
